title: Import with a visible result
description: The file’s columns are mapped to question, answer and attachments in a preview.

blocks.text: A blanket upload failure sends you cycling through editors without knowing what the error is.

quote.text: I want to create cards on my desktop windows PC but the app keeps rejecting my CSV files, whether from Excel, Notepad, Google Sheets or text in an email.

blocks.text: Show a sample of the cards to come, the specific problem rows and the part that was read successfully. Keep the setup for similar files.
After an import you have to check not only the text but also how images and audio are attached to the sides of the card.
